title: advertiser_link.v1
description: One edge between two ads: they share one identifying key directly. Clustering kinds (phone4, handle, name, title, desc, venue) link ads of the SAME advertiser; `photo` (the same media URL) is recorded but never clusters and may cross advertisers. Written by derive-advertisers to derived/advertiser_links.jsonl, ad_a < ad_b.

link_key.description: The shared value: phone4 = last 4 digits as written in the ad text; handle, name, venue = normalised; title, desc, photo = a 12-hex fingerprint (photo: of the exact media URL), never the text.

advertiser_b.description: ad_b's advertiser; equals advertiser_id for every clustering kind

used_for_clustering.description: false for photo: recorded for analysis, never merges advertisers
